explication: MPAndroidChart is an Android charting library: an application supplies chart-specific data and configures a chart view, which presents visualizations such as line, bar, pie, scatter, financial, bubble, combined, and radar charts. The library also supports chart interaction, selection, animation, formatting, and viewport transforms. The example app demonstrates these capabilities. The graph reflects the README and file tree; source excerpts are partial, so internal calls beyond the sampled Chart initialization are not expanded.
